name: B10-0084/2025 (ECR) – Case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Jean-Jacques Wondo, a Belgian military expert of Congolese origin who was sentenced to death in Kinshasa in September 2024. It says the evidence against him was weak and that he may have been caught up in a dispute inside the Congolese intelligence services. The Parliament also asks the Democratic Republic of the Congo to free others held without solid evidence, and asks the European Union to consider sanctions and to send its delegation to visit him in prison. The text is a request and a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament demands Wondo's immediate release, but the resolution cannot free him itself.
- It affects Wondo, other detainees in the Congo, and Congolese officials who could face European Union sanctions.
- Next, the European Union delegation in Kinshasa is asked to monitor the case and visit him in prison.
